newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Drug smugglers caught soaking clothes in cocaine.
newsitem.headline: Drug smugglers caught soaking clothes in cocaine.

text.p: Brazilian police arrested four Chinese nationals trying to smuggle clothes soaked in cocaine, national Globo television reported on Tuesday.
Globo said the Chinese had tried to cross from Paraguay into Brazil carrying T-shirts, ladies' underwear and other garments that had been immersed in cocaine dissolved in water.
Federal border agents in the city of Foz de Iguazu discovered the novel smuggling method when they tested the clothes with chemicals.
